result.stdout:
USAGE:
    pragmatic-migrate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    pragmatic-migrate apply --assembly bin/Debug/net10.0/MyApp.dll
    pragmatic-migrate apply --dry-run
    pragmatic-migrate apply --yes --force
    pragmatic-migrate status --assembly bin/Debug/net10.0/MyApp.dll
    pragmatic-migrate script --assembly bin/Debug/net10.0/MyApp.dll > 
migration.sql

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    apply       Apply pending migrations (default command)                      
    status      Show current vs desired schema diff without applying            
    script      Output SQL migration script to stdout                           
    snapshot    Write the desired schema to committed schema/<db>.schema.json   
                files                                                           
    history     Show migration audit history from __PragmaticSchema             
    manifest    Export manifest JSON from a compiled assembly                   
    generate    Generate C# client from manifest

DESCRIPTION:
Apply pending migrations (default command).

USAGE:
    pragmatic-migrate apply [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pragmatic-migrate apply --assembly bin/Debug/net10.0/MyApp.dll
    pragmatic-migrate apply --dry-run
    pragmatic-migrate apply --yes --force

OPTIONS:
                                 DEFAULT                                        
    -h, --help                              Prints help information             
    -v, --version                           Prints version information          
        --assembly <PATH>                   Path to built host assembly (.dll)  
                                            containing SG-generated             
                                            SchemaVersion types                 
        --project <PATH>                    Path to .csproj file. Builds the    
                                            project and loads the output        
                                            assembly                            
        --connection <STRING>               Override connection string for all  
                                            databases                           
        --config <PATH>                     Path to appsettings.json for        
                                            connection string resolution        
        --database <NAME>                   Filter to a specific database by    
                                            name                                
        --audit-table <NAME>                Audit table name, when the host     
                                            renamed it with UseAuditTable.      
                                            Default: __PragmaticSchema          
        --drop-unknown-tables               Drop tables present in the database 
                                            but absent from the declared schema.
                                            Off by default: a table the CLI did 
                                            not create may belong to another

DESCRIPTION:
Show current vs desired schema diff without applying.

USAGE:
    pragmatic-migrate status [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pragmatic-migrate status --assembly bin/Debug/net10.0/MyApp.dll

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -v, --version                Prints version information                     
        --assembly <PATH>        Path to built host assembly (.dll) containing  
                                 SG-generated SchemaVersion types               
        --project <PATH>         Path to .csproj file. Builds the project and   
                                 loads the output assembly                      
        --connection <STRING>    Override connection string for all databases   
        --config <PATH>          Path to appsettings.json for connection string 
                                 resolution                                     
        --database <NAME>        Filter to a specific database by name          
        --audit-table <NAME>     Audit table name, when the host renamed it with
                                 UseAuditTable. Default: __PragmaticSchema      
        --drop-unknown-tables    Drop tables present in the database but absent 
                                 from the declared schema. Off by default: a    
                                 table the CLI did not create may belong to     
                                 another system                                 
        --json                   Output structured NDJSON for programmatic      
                                 consumption (unidirectional)                   
        --agent                  Bidirectional NDJSON mode for AI agent         
                                 integration (reads stdin, writes stdout)       
        --verbose                Show SQL for each change as it executes        
        --no-color               Disable terminal colors

DESCRIPTION:
Generate C# client from manifest.

USAGE:
    pragmatic-migrate generate [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pragmatic-migrate generate --assembly bin/Debug/net10.0/MyApp.dll --output 
./Client/

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
    -v, --version                       Prints version information              
        --assembly <PATH>               Path to built assembly containing       
                                        PragmaticManifest                       
        --manifest <PATH>               Path to manifest.json file (alternative 
                                        to --assembly)                          
        --output <PATH>                 Output directory for generated client   
                                        project                                 
        --namespace <NS>                Namespace/package name for generated    
                                        code. Default: derived from manifest    
                                        assembly name                           
        --boundary <NAME>               Filter to specific boundary             
        --language <LANG>    csharp     Target language: csharp (default),      
                                        typescript
